北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感-9℃。注意保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is overcast and feels like -9°C. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 13℃。记得带伞，小心着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast, feels like 13°C. Remember an umbrella, and don't catch a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，注意添衣！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels like 10°C. Mind the temperature difference, dress warmly!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴好，体感 22℃。天气舒适，记得多喝水。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and feels like 22°C. Enjoy the pleasant weather and stay hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光明媚，体感 21℃。外出记得防晒哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels like 21°C. Don't forget sunscreen when you're out!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，体感 10℃。能见度低，出行请慢行。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, feels like 10°C. Low visibility, please drive slowly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雾蒙蒙，体感 5℃。风力稍大，注意保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy, feels like 5°C. A bit windy, stay warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 11℃。天气微凉，记得添衣哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 11°C. Slightly cool, remember to add a layer.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，体感 5℃。出门戴口罩，保护呼吸道。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, feels like 5°C. Wear a mask outdoors to protect your respiratory system.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感-1℃。气温很低，多穿点哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like -1°C. Very cold, dress warmly.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，体感 14℃。出门记得戴口罩，注意防护。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, feels like 14°C. Remember to wear a mask for protection.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天晴但极寒，体感-26℃。全副武装防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear but extremely cold, feels like -26°C. Bundle up to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -26℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感-20℃。风力较大，注意防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast and cold, feels like -20°C. Quite windy, stay warm.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 9℃。风力稍大，早晚添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 9°C. A bit windy, add layers morning and evening.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 18℃。天气宜人， Enjoy the day！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 18°C. Pleasant weather, enjoy your day!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阵雪，体感-3℃。路面湿滑，注意安全哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has snow showers, feels like -3°C. Roads are slippery, please be careful!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴冷，体感-14℃。风力大，多穿厚衣服！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast and cold, feels like -14°C. Windy, wear extra warm clothes!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
